profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company traded on the ticker DDOG, headquartered in New York, NY, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001561550. It also appears under the alias DATADOG INC - CLASS A. Its website, datadoghq.com, describes the company as offering cloud monitoring as a service, letting customers see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial offered.

The site's AI-related material is framed around security rather than a named AI product. Datadog describes integrating security and observability so organizations can decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with what it calls agentic speed against AI-powered attacks. No AI products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

The held record shows no lawsuits against Datadog. Its legal exposure is recorded in New York, with a count of 448.
